summary: Sensitive Content Analysis checks images and video for nudity with Apple's on-device model, behind a code-signing entitlement, and ties the result to the system Sensitive Content Warning and Communication Safety settings. BifrOSt has no such model, no entitlement and no matching system setting.

features.apple: Detecting sensitive content in media and providing intervention options (article)
features.note: no classifier and no intervention UI
Apple code-signing entitlement with no BifrOSt equivalent
decoders exist (springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs) but nothing classifies content

features.apple: Apple-issued QR code and test profile
